hotel.name: The Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Resort

verified_facts.text: A skywalk connects the pool deck directly to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cross our hotel's cleverly designed skywalk, which is directly connected from the pool deck to the beach.

verified_facts.text: The resort has 360-degree views of the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: With 360-degree views of the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic Ocean

verified_facts.text: Many rooms and suites offer ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Settle into one of our well-appointed rooms and suites, many of which offer ocean views.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an oceanfront pool deck with an outdoor pool, and Waves poolside bar and grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cool off from the South Florida sun with a refreshing dip in our outdoor pool. Enjoy fun for the whole family, unwind on the resort’s oceanfront pool deck with a cocktail or bite from Waves, our poolside bar and grill

verified_facts.text: Heavenly Spa covers 8,200 square feet, with eight treatment rooms including couples' suites, an infrared sauna and a co-ed relaxation lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into our 8,200-square-foot sanctuary of self-care, offering the ultimate relaxation and pampering, featuring eight treatment rooms (including couples' suites), fresh, airy modern, décor, infrared sauna and co-ed relaxation lounge

verified_facts.text: Heavenly Spa's treatments are inspired by tropical destinations such as Japan, Zanzibar, Fiji, Brazil, Costa Rica and Iceland.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the zen and tranquility of the globe’s most sought-after tropical destinations and exotic locales – from Japan, Zanzibar, Fiji, Brazil, Costa Rica, Iceland and beyond

verified_facts.text: Lona Cocina & Tequileria is a Mexican restaurant led by chef Pablo Salas, with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Chef Pablo Salas’ contemporary take on traditional Mexican fare at Lona Cocina & Tequileria.

verified_facts.text: Tinta serves breakfast with a Mexican twist, inside or on its oceanfront terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: A popular choice for beachfront dining in Fort Lauderdale, serving all your favorites with a Mexican twist. Dine inside or out on the restaurant's oceanfront terrace.

verified_facts.text: Outdoor wellness programs include yoga on the terrace, HIIT workouts and oceanside cycling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering a variety of activities such as HIIT workouts, yoga on the terrace, and oceanside cycling

verified_facts.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring 24/7 access to state-of-the-art gym equipment

verified_facts.text: Las Olas Boulevard, with a square mile of shopping and dining, is a quick walk from the hotel along the promenade.
verified_facts.excerpt: walk the promenade to Las Olas Boulevard. Here, you'll find a square mile of upscale shopping and dining just a quick walk from our hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is less than five miles from the Port Everglades cruise port.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is less than five miles from the cruise port

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the canals of the 'Venice of America' aboard the Water Taxi of Fort Lauderdale.
verified_facts.excerpt: tour the "Venice of America" with a ride aboard the Water Taxi of Fort Lauderdale

verified_facts.text: The Royal Palm Presidential Suite is a top-floor ocean-view corner suite with a whirlpool.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Presidential Suite, 1 King, Ocean view, Corner room, Top floor, Whirlpool

verified_facts.text: Up to two pets are welcome per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome you to bring up to two pets per room

verified_facts.text: On the beach, guests can enjoy beach chairs and non-motorized water sports.
verified_facts.excerpt: There, guests can enjoy beach chairs and non-motorized water sports, with umbrellas available for a fee.
